prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Pearland, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1167; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim reference.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where the collision occurred?

A: It was in a shopping center parking lot in Pearland, Texas, near one of the main entrances.

Q: What were you doing right before the impact?

A: I was pulling into an open space in a row. I had my turn signal on and was moving slowly, maybe five miles an hour.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not at first. It came out from the next row over, backing up. I saw it when it was already close, and I braked hard.

Q: Were you able to stop before contact?

A: No. The front of my car hit the rear passenger side of the other vehicle. It wasn't a high-speed hit, but it was enough to throw me forward against the wheel.

Q: Did you receive any injuries?

A: Yes. I put my right hand out to brace myself and I landed on it badly. The doctor later told me the wrist is fractured. I've got a cast and I can't drive for a while.

Q: Did you seek medical care that same day?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that afternoon. They took X-rays and referred me to an orthopedist for follow-up.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the collision?

A: Only that I was being careful and the other driver was backing out fast. I'd like this claim handled as quickly as possible.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
